test_overview: The server (FastAPI, port 8000) was up and login worked, but the RFP management frontend is entirely missing from the served application. The navbar exposes "RFPs", "Vendors", and "POs" links whose handlers call functions (renderRFPs, renderRFPDetail, renderVendors, renderPOs, viewRFP, loadRFPs, handleGetShareLink) that are all undefined in the served /static/app.js. Clicking nav-rfps is a no-op — the page stays on "All Service Bookings / No active bookings." and no error or RFP list appears. There is no RFP creation form or global create button anywhere in the UI. Consequently, in step 1 (test_owner_creates_rfp), the mandatory action "Create a new RFP" could not be performed by a human user. This is a FATAL failure: step 1 scores 0 and, because every subsequent step depends on the RFP "Corporate Campus HVAC Overhaul" existing (viewing it, editing it, creating POs against it, progressing its status, awarding it, creating a job, generating the share link, and guest access), the entire test plan fails per the fatal-failure rule. Steps 2–8 were not executed and were awarded 0 points. Backend API endpoints for RFPs/POs exist, but creating data via API calls would fabricate state not achievable through the UI and was therefore not used to rescue the plan. Final score: 0/25.

steps.description: test_owner_creates_rfp — Login as Marcus Webb succeeded, but the RFP creation UI is completely missing: clicking the app's own 'RFPs' nav link does nothing (content stays on 'All Service Bookings'), and the RFP render/handler functions referenced by the application's own code (renderRFPs, viewRFP, loadRFPs, etc.) are undefined in the served frontend. No form/button exists anywhere to create an RFP, so the required action could not be performed. FATAL failure — stops the whole test plan.
